status: future experiment recommendation only; not scheduled, implemented, run or self-approved
question: Does shortening gradient credit assignment retain a benefit when optimizer/EMA/scheduler cadence and row-loss masses are identical, or do the observed combo extras arise from cadence and normalization changes?
primary_hypothesis: Shorter gradient truncation has an independent learning effect under identical forward states, exposure, update cadence and objectives.
rival: Muon explains most of the bundle advantage; apparent chunk1000 extras depend on doubled optimizer/scheduler/EMA attempts or per-chunk loss mass, not shorter gradient credit assignment. Bootstrap8 could supply a separate target effect.

shared.architecture: GRU256 two layers, unchanged features and heads
shared.optimizer: same full-schedule recurrent Muon implementation/groups/settings for all four arms
shared.macrostep: one optimizer attempt, one clip, one scheduler advance and one EMA advance per2000 input rows; identical attempted/completed/EMA clocks must be observed
shared.forward: carry real incoming raw and detached EMA states; frozen weights within each2000-row macrostep; T1000 detaches hidden at the halfway point but never resets it
shared.loss: pool exact sufficient numerators and denominators across the SAME2000-row macrostep for main/EMA/struct/next; do NOT average1000-row normalized losses; all four arms use the identical macrostep loss functional
shared.targets: identical fold-bound cached teachers, alpha.5 and clipped scaled-teacher average; H8 uses existing strict stopping survival/end-of-sequence condition, H0 original target blend; training-only future targets never reach inference
shared.ema: same decay.999 per COMMON macrostep, distinct genuine detached EMA weights/state; no doubled EMA updates in T1000
shared.seed_and_exposure: seeds3 and4; exact initial tensors and externally frozen batch order shared between arms; no dependence on differing forward-call consumption of global RNG
shared.fit: same fold-specific fit rows, teachers, propensity, validation-in-fit true-mask weights, since weights and four epochs; fixed epoch index3, no in-fit evaluation or early checkpoint selection
shared.evaluation: component-disjoint manifests for folds0..3; these previously exposed folds remain confirmation/ablation data, not fresh holdout; no new exposure claim

admission_before_any_fit: controller must authorize resource plan; no GPU smoke/queue launch from this recommendation
capture and replay exact main/EMA/auxiliary loss, raw/EMA hidden state and optimizer/scaler/scheduler state in isolated code
same-weight same-initial-state forward/output and macrostep-loss parity between detach intervals; independent full-gradient coefficient oracle
tiny cross-half dependency control verifies T1000 blocks ONLY the cross-half gradient; negative control without cross-half dependence gives equal gradients
actual chosen backend step and skipped-update parity; unsupported fused/AMP/Muon paths block admission rather than filling missing state
macrostep scaling is a NEW controlled objective, not exact reproduction of present combo's per1000-row normalization
primary_measure: Delta_credit = .5 * [(WP(T1000_H0)-WP(T2000_H0)) + (WP(T1000_H8)-WP(T2000_H8))]; average paired seed-specific contrasts without treating seeds as independent components; pool centered moments across folds, then paired connected-component resampling2000 seed271828, SAME resample indices for all arms/seeds
secondary_descriptive: bootstrap8 main effect at fixed truncation
loss-gradient components, clip incidence and incoming hidden mismatch

decision.supports_independent_credit_effect: primary point>=.0005 and paired95% lower>0, both seeds positive; report class3 safeguards and fold heterogeneity
decision.supports_no_material_credit_effect_at_te: entire primary95% interval inside[-.0005,+.0005]; this is scoped equivalence, not proof that the original gain is caused by clocks
decision.inconclusive: otherwise; interval crossing0 alone is not evidence of equivalence
decision.bootstrap_interaction: secondary/descriptive unless a separate multiplicity-controlled confirmation is frozen before scoring
decision.no_claims: no global GRU optimum, unbiased conditional teacher, Assumption1, universal burn-in, missing-information or public-score claim

interpretation: This isolates gradient truncation conditional on fixed Muon and the common2000-row objective. A null leaves update cadence, mass normalization, bootstrap semantics and interaction as rivals. It cannot attribute the original bundle to one of those rivals without an additional controlled factor.
cost: four training arms x two seeds x four folds for a complete confirmation; resource duration unknown until controller-approved calibration. No cost/VRAM invented and no execution authorized by this document. A controller may preregister a smaller initial fit panel before launch but cannot call that the full design.
